07-precision-drawing: [confident] Clean plays read faster. Here's how to draw them clean.
Open Field controls. Snap to the grid, and every player lines up.
Pick your hash marks, and turn the yard lines up or down.
Right click any route to change the line, the weight, the color, or the end.
Turn on route depths, and every break shows its yards.
[excited] Sharp on the screen. Sharp on the wristband.
08-upload-any-play: [confident] Got plays on a whiteboard, or in a binder? Bring them with you.
Open Upload, and drop in a photo, a scan, or a PDF.
Grid Iron Vault reads the players, the routes, and the blocks.
Check the read, and fix anything with a click.
Save it, and it's a real play you can edit, teach, and print.
[excited] Your old playbook, in your new Vault.
09-griddy: [confident] Meet Griddy, your coaching assistant. He's on every page.
Ask for a play in plain words, and he draws it.
Like it? Save it straight to your Vault.
Tell him to recolor a whole playbook, and it's done. Undo is one click.
He'll even build a call sheet from the plays you already have.
[excited] Got a question? Just ask Griddy.
10-sets-and-defense: [confident] Line up faster. Formations and defenses are one click away.
Open Sets, pick a formation, and drop it on the ball.
Flip it left or right with one switch.
Need a look to beat? Pick a front and a coverage, and every defender gets a job.
Or turn your offense into a defense, matched to the formation.
[excited] Set it. Flip it. Coach it.
11-call-sheet: [confident] Game day runs on your call sheet. Build it right here.
Type a play name, and it links to the play in your Vault.
Paint your calls by situation, and add any column you need.
Find a call in a second, or fold away what you don't need.
Then print the sheet, and send the same calls to your wristbands.
12-practice-drills: [confident] A good practice is planned to the minute.
Build your script in timed periods, and watch the clock add up.
Drop in plays from your Vault, one at a time, or a whole playbook.
Open the Drill Vault for animated drills with coaching points.
Add a drill to tonight's practice, right from the Drill Vault.
[excited] Then print the script, and the scout cards.
13-my-team: [confident] Your roster, your depth chart, and your colors, all in one place.
Import your roster from a spreadsheet, parents and all.
Set your depth chart right on the field.
Add your logo and colors, and they show up on the field, the wristbands, and the PDFs.
Then text the whole team from your own phone.
14-playbooks-players: [confident] A playbook only works if your players know it.
Group your plays into a playbook, in the order you install them.
Share it with one link. No account, and no app to download.
Each player picks a letter, and sees their own job on every play.
Then the Griddy Quiz shows you who really knows it.
[excited] Teach it once. Let them study all week.
01-designer-tools: [confident] This is the Grid Iron Vault play designer. Let me show you around.
Every tool sits in one panel. Draw, routes, players, sets, playbooks, and style.
Open one section, and the rest fold away. No clutter.
Drop a formation from your own sets, right on the ball.
Click a receiver, pick a route, and it draws at real depth, in his color.
Tap a lineman, tap the defender, and the block is drawn.
Slide the line of scrimmage, and the whole play moves with it.
Edit, Field, Teach, and Go to, right up top. Undo is always one click away.
[excited] Draw it fast. Draw it right. Grid Iron Vault dot com.
02-film-room-3d: [confident] Your players learn it faster when they can see it. That's the Film Room.
Open any play, and press Teach.
Six steps. The look. The zones. The call.
The snap. The read. Your job.
Flip it to 3D, and the play runs on a real field.
Pick your camera. Behind the offense, the sideline, or straight overhead.
Record your voice for each step, or let it read for you.
[excited] Then turn it into a video for the meeting room.
03-wristbands: [confident] Draw the routes once. Wear them on game day.
Click a receiver, pick a route. One click, real depth.
Save it, and the play lands in your playbook.
Open Wristbands, pick the playbook, and the cards build themselves.
Same size in every box, numbered the way you call them.
Preview exactly what prints, then download the PDF.
[excited] From the designer to the wrist. Grid Iron Vault dot com.
04-every-tool: [excited] One Vault. Every tool a coach needs.
Teach them in the Film Room, even in 3D.
Plan practice from the Drill Vault.
Run your roster and your depth chart.
And ask Griddy, your coaching assistant.
[confident] Grid Iron Vault. Your whole playbook, in one place.
05-one-click-routes: [confident] Routes in one click. Here's how.
Click the receiver. Pick the route. Slant, three yards. Done.
Flip the break, or change the line end, right there.
Linemen? Tap him, tap the defender, and he blocks.
In five on five and seven on seven, your center runs routes too.
06-coverage-check: [confident] Will it beat Cover 3? Find out before Saturday.
Open Teach, and run the Coverage check.
Every look gets a grade. Green means it wins.
See who's open, who's tight, and who's covered.
Then build your call sheet from the plays that win.
[excited] Know it works, before you call it.
15-film-room-cameras: [confident] Teach any play in the Film Room, now from twelve different cameras.
Start behind the offense, and watch the whole play unfold.
Jump to the quarterback cam, and ride with him to the throw.
Go wide, high above the end zone, to the sideline, or straight overhead.
Follow any one player, or look through his helmet.
[excited] One play. Twelve ways to teach it.
